The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has 32 books across its pages, and five of them are rated five stars. The other four cost £23.05, £25.37, £48.35 and £52.30. The browser tab is still open on the Mystery category page.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/mystery_3/index.html; agent-browser --session $S eval "(async()=>{let out=[];let u=location.href;while(u){const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(await (await fetch(u)).text(),'text/html');d.querySelectorAll('article.product_pod').forEach(a=>out.push([a.querySelector('p.star-rating').className,a.querySelector('h3 a').title,a.querySelector('.price_color').textContent]));const n=d.querySelector('li.next a');u=n?new URL(n.getAttribute('href'),u).href:null}return JSON.stringify({n:out.length,f:out.filter(x=>x[0].includes('Five'))})})()"
